title: mail: workspace and crate skeleton
description:
Add crates/mail/ to workspace Cargo.toml. Create crates/mail/Cargo.toml with dependencies: axum, tokio (full), sqlx (sqlite, runtime-tokio), serde/serde_json, tracing/tracing-subscriber, usenet-ipfs-core, usenet-ipfs-reader (lib). Create src/lib.rs and src/main.rs with parse_args (--config required) and a main() stub that loads config and logs startup.

Why: without a compilable crate no further work can proceed.

Acceptance: cargo build -p usenet-ipfs-mail succeeds with empty implementation.
